window-1.title: Weavesilk
window-1.blurb: Drag your cursor and it blooms into mirrored glowing filaments — it's less a toy than an instrument, and you'll absolutely end up screenshotting one and building a whole poster around it.

window-2.title: One Photographer's Decade of Dressing up as Dolly Parton
window-2.blurb: Ten years of one woman fully becoming Dolly — it's the most committed-to-the-bit persona project I've seen in ages, and it's basically your side-quest philosophy with a wig and a rhinestone budget.

window-3.title: Sour Plum Drink (Suan Mei Tang – 酸梅汤)
window-3.blurb: A smoky, deep-magenta grandma-era cooler you simmer for an hour instead of shaking — heritage in a glass, and it photographs like a dream on film.

window-4.title: The Vintage Kitchen in This NYC Apartment Is Renter-Friendly
window-4.blurb: It's a rental made to look like it has decades of history behind it using nothing but paint and good junk-shop instincts — basically a side quest with your name on it.

window-5.title: Wanglee Cafe, Toa Payoh
window-5.blurb: Three brothers from a zi char family running a retro air-con kopitiam of kaya toast and chilli pan mee — it's heritage nostalgia you can actually eat, and the whole place is begging to be shot on 35mm.
